The documents don't show Räikkönen winning any Grand Prix for Lotus F1. He appears in them only for McLaren (2005, 2006) and Ferrari (2015, 2018), where he finished 4th and 5th in the Japanese GPs and withdrew from the 2005 US GP. Lotus F1 appears only in the 2015 Japanese GP, with Grosjean and Maldonado. The documents also don't cover his 2012–2013 Lotus period, so this answer rests on the provided information alone and does not confirm that period.
